rationale: Artem's deep expertise in LLM inference, transformer architectures, and ML systems directly complements Georgi's vision for agentic workflow automation at Rilo. Georgi is actively building multi-agent GTM systems and hiring for execution-focused roles — Artem's hands-on background in efficient inference and open-source LLM research (loopvlm, PyTorch implementations) could be valuable for optimizing agent performance at scale.
intro_message: Artem, meet Georgi — he's building AI-powered multi-agent systems for GTM automation at Rilo and is actively hiring; your work on efficient LLM inference and transformer architectures could directly impact how his agents perform in production.
